## What this is

A TypeScript package that **predicts and proactively alerts about issues
before they occur** — a smart notification system that uses AI to decide
*when* a notification is worth sending (not just what to send). It was
extracted from the larger `PersonalLog` monorepo as a standalone, reusable
tool.

The package publishes `@superinstance/ai-smart-notifications` and bundles
to ESM via `tsup`. The source is four `.ts` files (`engine.ts`,
`timing.ts`, `types.ts`, `index.ts`) plus build config.

## What it was good at

- **Timing intelligence** — `src/timing.ts` is the interesting file. It
  decides when to send a notification based on user attention patterns,
  importance decay, and quiet-hours logic. Most notification systems only
  handle *what* to send; this one handles *whether/when*.
- **Pure TypeScript, ESM-native** — modern build, modern export surface.
  Consumable directly from any ESM-compatible frontend.
- **Standalone extraction** — the commit message (*"extract
  AI-Smart-Notifications as independent tool"*) shows the design intent:
  pull the notification engine out of the PersonalLog monolith so other
  projects can adopt it.
- **Minimal surface** — 4 source files, ~handful of exported symbols.
  Easy to read end-to-end.

The timing-decision surface (the heuristics in `timing.ts`) is the part
worth re-reading if you're building any "should I notify the user?" logic.

## Why we moved on

Smart notifications became a saturated space — operating systems, email
clients, and chat apps all shipped their own "do-not-disturb" / "priority"
heuristics between 2024 and 2025. The implementation here is sound but
the *value of building it* dropped as platform-level primitives caught up.

This archive preserves the moment when the team still thought a
project-specific notification engine was worth its own package. The
extraction commit (`0c7463d`) was the high-water mark.

## How to use this archive

```bash
npm install
npm run build      # tsup -> dist/
npm test           # vitest
```

The package exports the notification engine and timing helpers; the README
walks through the public API and a few usage patterns.

## How to get the big pieces

No model weights, no datasets, no vendored binaries. This is a pure
TypeScript library; everything you need is in the repo. The `dist/`
folder is generated by `tsup` from `src/` and is not committed (per
`.gitignore`).

## Salvageable mechanisms

- **Decoupling "what to notify" from "when to notify"** — even if you don't
  use this package wholesale, the *separation of concerns* in `engine.ts`
  vs. `timing.ts` is worth borrowing.
- **Importance decay curves** — `timing.ts` implements decay logic that
  reduces the priority of stale notifications. Useful for any "what
  should I surface now?" UX.
- **ESM-first TypeScript package layout** — clean, minimal, modern. A
  good template for extracting a small package out of a monorepo.

## Provenance

This archive was preserved as part of the SuperInstance collection by an
external archiver (Mini-Agent) working through `C:\reseachlocal` in
September 2026. The original folder had no remote configuration — this is
the first time the work has been published.

A repo named `SuperInstance/AI-Smart-Notifications` already exists
upstream; the local package was likely the seed of that work. To avoid
colliding with the upstream naming, this archive is published under
`SuperInstance/ai-smart-notifications` (lowercase, matching the npm
package name) — the upstream repo and this archive may differ.

The original branch was `master`; this repository uses `main` as the
default branch for consistency with the rest of the SuperInstance archive.
